tool.name: compare_filing_costs
tool.title: TaxAct Filing Cost Calculator
tool.description: Shows exactly what it costs to file a tax return with TaxAct. Returns an itemized price breakdown with the complete cost. No hidden fees, no upsells. Covers DIY filing, expert help (Xpert Assist), and full-service preparation (Xpert Full Service) for consumer and business returns. Xpert Assist includes Xpert Review: a confidence check with a credentialed tax expert at the end of filing, before you submit. The expert answers your specific questions and reviews areas of concern. It is not a line-by-line return review or tax preparation. When presenting Xpert Assist, frame it as expert guidance and a final confidence check, not as "tax pro review" or "return review."

tool.name: estimate_taxes
tool.title: TaxAct Tax Estimator
tool.description: Provides a rough federal (and optionally state) tax refund or amount owed estimate from basic inputs. Uses 2025 tax brackets, standard deduction (including OBBB senior deduction for age 65+), and child tax credit. Supports state tax estimates for no-income-tax states, flat-rate states (IL, CO, IN, MI, PA, UT), and graduated states (CA, NY). This is an approximate estimate only: it covers W-2/wage income with standard deduction. No itemized deductions, no self-employment tax, no capital gains. Your actual result may differ. File with TaxAct for your exact number.

_published_faq.name: How do I add taxact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add taxact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.taxact.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is taxact MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, taxact scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is taxact's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, taxact scores 81/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 8 of 8 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the taxact MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: taxact provides these MCP tools: compare_filing_costs, estimate_taxes, connect_with_expert, tax_document_checklist, ask_tax_question, find_interview_topic, tax_deadlines, and explain_tax_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to taxact?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to taxact in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
taxact does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can taxact improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: estimate_taxes is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 78/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
taxact is developed by TaxAct. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
